context: Owner decision 2026-11-08: tracker item only; not fixed in the release-remediation run.
description: On 2026-11-08 GitHub's release download links (github.com/joeharris76/theseus/releases/download/v0.2.4/...) returned HTTP 504 for about an hour, so every hosted review and CI Theseus install failed before review started. The release-asset API (GET /repos/joeharris76/theseus/releases/assets/<id> with Accept: application/octet-stream) returned the exact locked bytes (sha256 c0c4c201...ce49e8c) throughout. Add that route as a fallback in the Theseus bootstrap installer, keeping the SHA-256 check and the allowed-host policy; ship via a Theseus release and a normal pin promotion.
